Package com.saicone.types.util

Class WrappedPair<LeftA,​LeftB,​RightA,​RightB>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.saicone.types.util.WrappedPair<LeftA,​LeftB,​RightA,​RightB>
  • Type Parameters:
    LeftA - the base type of left object.
    LeftB - the type of object to represent left A.
    RightA - the base type of right object.
    RightB - the type of object to represent right A.
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    WrappedMap, WrappedMap.Entry
    public class WrappedPair<LeftA,​LeftB,​RightA,​RightB>
extends Object
    Represents a two-dimensional Object with its respective left and right type A that can be converted to left and right type B.
